children: Bunzl's raised guidance should drive an upgrade to earnings per share consensus, Bernstein's Will Kirkness and Filippo Giardini write in a note. The U.K. distribution and services group launched a new 500 million-pound share buyback plan and said it now expects its full-year operating margin to be broadly flat. The analysts anticipate EPS consensus to move up in the low single digits. Shares are down 0.1% at 27.90 pounds. (najat.kantouar@wsj.com)
